skills.name: Fury of Roan
skills.description:
Sweep Roan's spear, which is strengthened by rage, to deal damage to enemies in front of you. Can be used without casting while attacking with Spear of Lugh.
[Shining Sentinel] Cast Fury of Roan to summon 1 Shining Sentinel for a period of time. The Shining Sentinel finds the nearest enemy in range and attacks them multiple times, dealing damage, then disappears. If there is a boss within range, the sentinel will prioritize that boss. Not affected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Shield of Chulainn
skills.description: Creates a protective shield with Chulainn's spear fragments to neutralize attacks. Unaffected by cooldown reset effects. Creates a barrier upon successfully comboing Fury of Roan and Sting of Roan by using Spear of Lugh. Unaffected by Buff Duration increases.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Spear of Light
skills.description: Summons Gram by channeling purified light for a period of time, attacking enemies nearby. Spear of Light is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Will of Light
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through.
The Will of Light can be used while other skills are active.

skills.name: Light's Blessing
skills.description: Creates a protective shield with the power of light.

skills.name: Impulse of Chulainn
skills.description: Unleashes Chulainn's piercing spear from the sky, dealing damage to enemies in front of you.

skills.name: Piercing of Chulainn
skills.description: Grants the Piercing of Chulainn buff for a period of time to increase Final Damage.

skills.name: Hundred Pole
skills.description: Raises countless spears from an armory of light for a period of time to increase Critical Damage.

skills.name: Eternal Light
skills.description:
[Passive Trigger Conditions] Additionally activates Eternal Light when using Spear of Lugh.\r

[Eternal Light] Manifests the blinding light of eternity to deal damage to enemies within an area. Has a reactivation cooldown.\r

[Radiant Sentinel] Eternal Light summons 1 Radiant Sentinel for a period of time when activated. The Radiant Sentinel finds and deals damage to the nearest enemy in range. If there is a boss within range, the sentinel will prioritize that boss.

skills.name: Sentinel Rise
skills.description: Rallies the Shining Sentinels to fight against the darkness. Shining Sentinel summoned with this skill persist for a short period of time and disappear once their attack ends.

skills.name: Eternal Guardian
skills.description:
Summons the Sentinel Captain, materialized from divine power, and marks enemies with your Guardian's Gaze. Landing Roan attack skills a certain number of times while Guardian's Gaze is active will trigger Judgment of Light, which attacks the enemies marked by Guardian's Gaze.
Attacks the boss with the highest Max HP first, and is unaffected by attack reflection.
Right-click to toggle the effect on/off.
